description: This Dart file defines an AuthProvider class responsible for managing user authentication state, token persistence, login/logout operations, and real-time service connection in a Flutter project. It interacts with API and real-time services, handles session loading, and supports mock mode for testing.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A provider class managing authentication state, including login, logout, session loading, token handling, user info, and real-time service connections.

methods.name: AuthProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing API and real-time service instances.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Factory constructor initializing AuthProvider with API and real-time services with token getter.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads session data from local storage, verifies user authentication, and establishes real-time connection.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, supports mock mode, persists token, fetches user info, and connects real-time service.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication token, user info, and disconnects real-time services.
